issues.issue: On a de novo appeal from a removal order, must the IAD decide whether the marriage was genuine when the ID did not decide it?
issues.applicant_position: Minister: the IAD wrongly declined to consider the genuineness of the marriage, the basis of the misrepresentation alleged in the s.44 report.
issues.respondent_position: Peirovdinnabi: genuineness was not in play, and the IAD implicitly found the marriage genuine by finding no withdrawal.
issues.result_quote: since the IAD wrongly declined to exercise its jurisdiction to determine whether Mr Peirovdinnabi had entered into the marriage for immigration purposes

issues.issue: Should the IAD decision also be set aside because its finding of no misrepresentation was perverse or capricious under s.18.1(4)(d)?
issues.applicant_position: Minister: the IAD's finding that there was no misrepresentation was perverse, capricious or made without regard to the material.
issues.result_quote: I need not decide the second, factual issue raised by the Minister.
